data.title: Tom Lee Says Ethereum’s Years-Long Slide Against Bitcoin Is Ending. Ethereum Lost Another 4.6% to Bitcoin in a Week.
data.description: Tom Lee is calling the end of Ethereum's long slide against Bitcoin, pointing to tokenized stocks and AI agents as the catalysts. But the data from the very week he made that call tells a very different story.
